title: Fix local account discovery for evaluations page in demo mode
description: Resolve local-mode account list failure (No account found) by aligning dashboard local amplify list behavior with local GraphQL roots and seeded account records.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented local proxy CORS support for browser-mode dashboard calls: added CORSMiddleware in proxy/app.py and configurable PLEXUS_PROXY_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS in proxy/config.py. Added regression test test_graphql_endpoint_supports_local_cors_preflight in services/private-graphql-proxy/tests/test_app_routing.py. Verified with OPTIONS preflight from Origin http://localhost:3000 returning 200 and access-control-allow-origin header, plus dockerized test run of test_app_routing passing.
